out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the kitchen being used as a storage for Bay leave containers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC trained employees on designated use of the handwashing sink. GUAPO'S ROTISSERIE OF HERNDON (Inspection Date: 06/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink in kitchen and at the service line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at each handwashing sink during inspection.

violations.title: Hot Water and Chemical Sanitizing, Immersion Time
violations.observation: Dishwashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 10ppm chlorine. The dish-ware is not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: After being cleaned, the food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in manual hot water operations by immersion for at least 30seconds at a water temperature of at least 171F. PIC discontinued use the dish machine and set up 3 compartment sink for properly sanitizing dish-ware. PIC properly sanitized the dish-ware.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Mozzarella cheese (blocks) at 49F, unsalted butter at 51F, cooked beans at 49F, tomato sauce at 49F, cooked chicken at 50F in WIC # 2 (50F) and raw tilapia at 46F in 2 DR prep cooler at service line (45F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded Mozzarella cheese, unsalted butter, cooked beans, tomato sauce, cooked chicken from WIC#2 and raw Tilapia from 2 DR prep cooler. PIC relocated other TCS food items, which had been stored in WIC and 2 DR prep cooler for no more than 4 hours to another unit maintaining the proper temperature.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: WIC#2 at 50F
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC discarded raw shell eggs.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Observed wet wiping cloths used for placement under cutting boards at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloth in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC#2 at 50F and @ DR prep cooler at 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discontinued use of the WIC#2, 2 DR prep cooler and contacted a technician during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles with varieties of sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all squeeze bottles with varieties of sauces.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed soy sauce containers stored directly on the floor next to ice machine .
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved soy sauce containers to approved shelving.

violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.Please install a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connection under the handwashing sink piping is leaking at service area.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC contacted a technician during the inspection. PIC will email a technician’s invoice after repair is completed.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment was observed soiled to sight and touch: a can opener.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC cleaned and sanitized the can opener.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): chicken soup
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC received written procedure and was instructed on proper procedures for managing chicken soup using Time as a Public Health Control. GUAPO'S ROTISSERIE OF HERNDON (Inspection Date: 03/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed squid, scallops, shrimps thawing at room temperature in a bucket next to the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC was informed about proper methods and subsequently moved squid, shrimps, scallops into WIC.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed unlabeled squeeze bottles throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all squeeze bottles throughout.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: The ice scoop handle was observed in direct contact with the ice being used for food in the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC placed the ice scoop in the container.
